title: F. Architecture and Lens quality
definition: System boundaries and responsibilities are accurate; the L0 System → L5 Source hierarchy is correct; each component keeps one identity at every level; dependencies and flows can be followed; code evidence is linked where the source gives it; unknown details stay unknown.
questions: Are system boundaries and responsibilities accurate?
Is the HLD-to-LLD hierarchy correct (each level at its own abstraction)?
Are the same components represented consistently at different levels?
Can users follow important dependencies and flows (trace, drill-down, roll-up)?
Is available code evidence linked correctly?

severity.critical: A component with two identities; a drill-down to the wrong component; invented internals, code or paths; a reversed edge in the projection.
severity.major: A level frame missing its level; an edge relation changed by projection; a missing roll-up.
severity.minor: A node's kind differs from the expected one but is still reasonable.

deterministic: lens_node, lens_edge, lens_drill, lens_identity, lens_no_children, lens_path on the projection
model_judge: 'Does each level show only what belongs at it?'
human: Walk L0 → L5 for the HLD-to-LLD case; check every L5 location against the source

requiredAssertions: lens_identity for every component that appears at more than one level
lens_no_children for every component the source leaves undescribed
lens_path for the main HLD-to-LLD journey
passCriteria: All critical Lens assertions pass on the projection of the generated canvas; the walk-through finds no level mixing.
failCriteria: Any identity, drill, direction or invented-detail failure.
passExample: Orchestrator at L1 drills to its four parts at L2; the Answer composer drills to the request flow at L3; step 5 drills to composeAnswer at L4; L5 shows compose.ts lines 40–118 and no code.
failExample: L2 redraws 'Orchestrator service' as a new box beside its parts; the Ingestion worker gets an invented L2 and a services/ingestion path.

judgeScale.meaning: Levels mixed, identities duplicated, details invented.
Correct hierarchy; one roll-up or level label missing.
Every level at its abstraction, one identity per component, evidence exact, unknowns explicit.
